description: Build a moving-head lighting rig with BOTH a DMX/Art-Net output chain AND a 3D visual previsualization. For each fixture: a Constant CHOP holds an 8-channel movingHead8 block (pan, tilt, dimmer, r, g, b, strobe, gobo, prefixed '<id>/…'), padded and merged into a dmxoutCHOP (`interface`, `universe`, `netaddress`, `rate`); and a Geometry COMP 'head' with a tube-cone beam whose pan→ry and tilt→rx rotation is expression-driven straight from that fixture's DMX pan/tilt channels (0-255 mapped across pan_range/tilt_range degrees), all rendered under one camera+light Render TOP. This adds the live 3D preview on top of what create_dmx_fixture_pipeline (DMX-out only) does. Bind individual channels later with bind_to_channel / animate_parameter on op('rig_out')['fix1/pan']; the previz updates automatically.

beam_angle.description: Half-angle of the previz beam cone (degrees) — narrow = spot, wide = wash.

beam_length.description: Length of the previz beam cone from the head (metres).

fixtures.description: Moving-head fixtures. Each becomes a DMX movingHead8 block + a 3D previz head+beam.

id.description: Constant-CHOP name + channel prefix + previz Geometry name. Must be a valid TD name.

startChannel.description: 1-based DMX slot of this fixture's pan channel (movingHead8 uses 8 slots).

x.description: World X position of the fixture head in the 3D previz rig (metres).

y.description: World Y position (rig height) of the fixture head in the previz rig (metres).

z.description: World Z position of the fixture head in the 3D previz rig (metres).

host.description: Target IP for Art-Net / sACN (dmxoutCHOP `netaddress`). Null = leave default.

name.description: Base name for the container COMP.

net.description: Network protocol — written to the dmxoutCHOP `interface` par.

pan_range.description: Physical pan sweep in degrees the fixture spans across DMX 0-255 (previz rotation).

parent_path.description: COMP to create the fixture rig container in (default '/project1').

tilt_range.description: Physical tilt sweep in degrees the fixture spans across DMX 0-255 (previz rotation).

universe.description: DMX universe written to the dmxoutCHOP.

name: create_fixture_control
title: Create moving-head fixture control + 3D previz
